# Derived Subtlety Benchmark

These specimens are synthetic sensitivity tests derived from real exploit families already observed in the corpus.

Purpose:
- test whether `C_gates_plus_primitives` can outperform `B_deterministic_gates` on semantically subtle fraud
- vary exploit visibility while keeping the code executable

These are not organic historical runs. They are controlled adversarial variants.
